interface.shortDescription: Test a local Python MCP server
interface.longDescription: A local MCP server and live dashboard for two-way message, JSON data, and event exchange with a paired Chrome extension. Includes a clear-all control that resets local test data and pairing.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Local MCP Test to check the local server, send messages or data to the paired Chrome extension, and read its inbox with get_extension_messages when asked to check for incoming Chrome messages.

name: local-mcp-test
description: Test local MCP connectivity and exchange messages, data, and events with a paired Chrome extension.
